page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, centred. Page number at top right. Sections XXXVII to XL are numbered by bare Roman numerals on their own lines, with citations in italics after each section.

main_text.l: pere cupiunt, audiētes dicente Apostolo, Hu-
iusmodi Christo Domino nostro non seruiunt,
sed suo ventri. Et perdulces sermones & bene-
dictiones seducunt corda innocentium. lib.1. Dialogorum adu.Pelagium.
XXXVII.
Ita infecit [hæc Secta] corda multorum, vt cùm
superatos damnatosque esse se sentiant, tamen
venena mentium non omittant: & quod solù
possunt nos oderunt, per quos putant se libert-
atem docendæ hæreseos perdidisse. Item. Ex-
ceptis verbis tinnulis & emendicatis, nihil ali-
ud loquitur. Epist.79.ad Alyp.& Augusti.
XXXVIII.
De purissimo fonte Scripturarum assumen-
tes testimonia, non ita interpretantur vt scri-
pta sunt, sed simplicitatem sermonis Ecclesia-
stici id volunt significare quod ipsi sentiant.
XXXIX.
Dispensatio ac libratio ista prudens verbo-
rum indoctos decipere potest. Cautus auditor
& lector cito deprehendet insidias, & cunicu-
los, quibus veritas subuertitur, aperte in luce
demonstrabit. Item. Venena erroris circumli-
nebant melle verborum. Item. Eadem nunc in
veteri & noua hæresi consuetudo seruatur, vt
aliud populi audiant, aliud prædicent sacerdo-
tes. Epist.61.ad Pammachium.
XL.
Dum inter multum magistrorum & venena
pariter bibunt, à magistro Apostolo recesserunt,

page.notes: Section XL ends with a full line and no catchword, so the paragraph continues on the next page. The words "pariter bibunt, à magistro Apostolo recesserunt" are underlined in the scan; this is most likely a mark on the paper, not printed text, so I have not reproduced it as emphasis. The form "recesserunt" is read from a worn letter and may be "recesserūt". In "ad Alyp.& Augusti" the name "Alyp." is read with some uncertainty. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible on the right margin and is not transcribed. The "Item." words are italic, and the bracketed "[hæc Secta]" is printed in the original as an interpolation.
